title: Online Doctor in Cabo | Video Consultation $59
description: See an English-speaking doctor by video in Cabo for $59 USD, tax included. Advice, next steps and a doctor at your hotel or our clinic if you need one.
h1: Online doctor in Cabo: video consultation for $59
image_alt: Traveler talking with an English-speaking doctor by video from a hotel in Cabo
whatsapp: Hi! I'd like a video consultation with a doctor. My symptoms are:
intro: Not every problem needs a doctor at your door. For many questions on vacation — a rash, a cough that will not quit, a medicine you forgot at home, or simply “should I worry about this?” — a video consultation with an English-speaking doctor is the fastest and most affordable first step.
A video consultation costs $59 USD, tax included. If the doctor decides you need to be examined in person, we arrange a visit at your hotel ($189) or at our downtown clinic ($99).

sections.h2: What a video consultation is good for
list: Deciding whether you need to see a doctor in person, go to a hospital or simply rest
Mild cold or flu symptoms, sore throat or cough
Mild stomach upset and how to stay hydrated
Skin rashes, insect bites and sunburn
Questions about a medicine you take or forgot at home
Follow-up after a visit with our doctors

p: Some problems need an exam: high fever in a child, severe pain, trouble breathing or anything that is getting worse quickly. In those cases the doctor will tell you honestly and we arrange an in-person visit. For an emergency — chest pain, trouble breathing, signs of a stroke, severe bleeding — call 911.

list: Message us on WhatsApp at +52 624 226 1023 or book online.
We confirm a time and send you the video link.
You talk with the doctor in English or Spanish from your room, villa or anywhere with a good connection.
If medicine is needed and can be given, our pharmacy can deliver it to your room.

p: Video consultation: $59 USD, tax included. We accept international health and travel insurance from the United States and Canada, subject to policy verification — verify your insurance before the call. See every price on our price list.

faq.q: How much is an online doctor visit in Cabo?
faq.a: A video consultation with our English-speaking doctors costs $59 USD, tax included.

faq.q: Can I see a doctor by video from my hotel in Cabo?
faq.a: Yes. We send you a video link at the confirmed time; you only need a phone or laptop with a good connection.

faq.q: What if I need to be examined?
faq.a: The doctor will tell you, and we arrange a visit at your hotel, villa or yacht ($189) or at our downtown clinic ($99).

faq.q: Is a video consultation for emergencies?
faq.a: No. For chest pain, trouble breathing, signs of a stroke or severe bleeding, call 911.
